scripts.init.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# video-production init script draft (env-spike-20261025). Runs as root, cwd /home/user, fails fast.
set -euo pipefail
ts() { date +%s.%N; }
echo "STEP start $(ts) user=$(id -un) uid=$(id -u) cwd=$PWD"
# A plain build-time variable is visible to the script; record only its sha256.
printf 'STEP build_plain_seen=%s sha256=%s\n' "${OMA_SPIKE_BUILD_PLAIN:+yes}" "$(printf %s "${OMA_SPIKE_BUILD_PLAIN:-}" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
mkdir -p /opt/oma
printf %s "${OMA_SPIKE_BUILD_PLAIN:-}" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1 > /opt/oma/spike-build-plain.sha256

work=$(mktemp -d)
# GitHub is not reachable directly from ACS pods (see report); only GitHub downloads use the proxy given as a plain build variable.
echo "STEP github_proxy=${OMA_GITHUB_PROXY:+set}"
VFS_URL=https://github.com/welltop-cn/vfs-cli-dist/releases/download/v0.3.21/vfs-cli_v0.3.21_linux_amd64.tar.gz
VFS_SHA=13a8125d6083d4747fe74b6d74142121c8c272c10f77b23e5b22334ab48abacb
MK_URL=https://github.com/volcengine/mediakit-cli/releases/download/v0.2.1/mediakit-cli_0.2.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz
MK_SHA=8c25ebd7c9446813dabb27700a9d4357c7d2325e528fe9caab31696aa1326987

echo "STEP fetch_vfs $(ts)"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 300 ${OMA_GITHUB_PROXY:+--proxy "$OMA_GITHUB_PROXY"} -o "$work/vfs.tgz" "$VFS_URL"
echo "$VFS_SHA  $work/vfs.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf "$work/vfs.tgz" -C "$work" vfs-cli
install -m 0755 "$work/vfs-cli" /usr/local/bin/vfs-cli
echo "STEP fetch_mediakit $(ts)"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 300 ${OMA_GITHUB_PROXY:+--proxy "$OMA_GITHUB_PROXY"} -o "$work/mk.tgz" "$MK_URL"
echo "$MK_SHA  $work/mk.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf "$work/mk.tgz" -C "$work" mediakit-cli
install -m 0755 "$work/mediakit-cli" /usr/local/bin/mediakit-cli
echo "STEP pip $(ts)"
pip install --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check google-genai==2.22.0 tomli-w==1.2.0
echo "STEP apt $(ts)"
apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends jq vim-tiny file
echo "STEP profile $(ts)"
cat > /etc/profile.d/oma-spike.sh <<'PROFILE'
export OMA_SPIKE="${OMA_SPIKE:-from-profile}"
export OMA_SPIKE_HARD="from-profile-hard"
PROFILE
chmod 0644 /etc/profile.d/oma-spike.sh
# Something root-owned under /home/user, to be fixed by the chown step.
mkdir -p /home/user/.oma-spike && echo built-as-root > /home/user/.oma-spike/marker
rm -rf "$work"
vfs-cli --version; mediakit-cli --version; jq --version; file --version | head -1; update-alternatives --query editor | grep -E "^Value"
echo "STEP done $(ts)"

scripts.write-manifest.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Emits /opt/oma/manifest.json content on stdout (spike version of /opt/oma/bin/write-manifest).
set -euo pipefail
v() { "$@" 2>&1 | head -1 || true; }
dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}\t${Version}\n' > /tmp/oma-dpkg.tsv
pip freeze --disable-pip-version-check 2>/dev/null > /tmp/oma-pip.txt || true
npm ls -g --depth=0 --json 2>/dev/null > /tmp/oma-npm.json || echo '{}' > /tmp/oma-npm.json
{
  printf 'vfs-cli\t%s\n' "$(v vfs-cli --version)"
  printf 'mediakit-cli\t%s\n' "$(v mediakit-cli --version)"
  printf 'ffmpeg\t%s\n' "$(v ffmpeg -version)"
  printf 'jq\t%s\n' "$(v jq --version)"
  printf 'node\t%s\n' "$(v node --version)"
  printf 'tini\t%s\n' "$(v tini --version)"
  printf 'python3\t%s\n' "$(v python3 --version)"
} > /tmp/oma-bin.tsv
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
def tsv(p): return dict(l.rstrip('\n').split('\t', 1) for l in open(p) if '\t' in l)
pip = dict(l.strip().split('==', 1) for l in open('/tmp/oma-pip.txt') if '==' in l)
try: npm = {k: v.get('version') for k, v in json.load(open('/tmp/oma-npm.json')).get('dependencies', {}).items()}
except Exception: npm = {}
print(json.dumps({'schema': 1, 'binaries': tsv('/tmp/oma-bin.tsv'), 'dpkg': tsv('/tmp/oma-dpkg.tsv'), 'pip': pip, 'npm': npm}, sort_keys=True))
PY
rm -f /tmp/oma-dpkg.tsv /tmp/oma-pip.txt /tmp/oma-npm.json /tmp/oma-bin.tsv
scripts.Dockerfile.base-tini:
# Spike stand-in for oma-media: live auto-story-v2 image + tini as PID 1.
FROM registry-vpc.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/welltop/oma-sandbox@sha256:67a46af66d3a53f4034b5c4d2c482a0b411718a3e923194bc547ab9528f3ba8d
USER root
RUN env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy bash -euo pipefail -c '      apt-get update &&       DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends tini &&       rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && /usr/bin/tini --version'
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/tini", "-g", "--"]
CMD ["bash", "/root/.jupyter/start-up.sh"]
LABEL dev.oma.spike="env-spike-20261025" dev.oma.base-of="welltop/oma-sandbox@sha256:67a46af66d3a53f4034b5c4d2c482a0b411718a3e923194bc547ab9528f3ba8d"
scripts.Dockerfile.env-video.in:
# Generated-Dockerfile shape from ADR-0024 (spike). BASE_REF is substituted by the driver.
FROM @BASE_REF@
RUN --mount=type=bind,source=init.sh,target=/tmp/oma-init.sh \
    --mount=type=bind,source=build.env,target=/tmp/oma-build.env \
    cd /home/user && set -a && . /tmp/oma-build.env && set +a && \
    env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy bash -euo pipefail /tmp/oma-init.sh
RUN --mount=type=bind,source=write-manifest.sh,target=/run/oma-write-manifest \
    chown -R user:user /home/user && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /root/.cache /tmp/* \
    && mkdir -p /opt/oma && bash /run/oma-write-manifest > /opt/oma/manifest.json
LABEL dev.oma.environment=env_spike_video_production dev.oma.build=bld_spike_20261025
